services_source.title: Technical Appendix: Measuring the AI Economy
services_source.authors: Patrick McKelvey, Leopold Brown, Yuval Rhymon, Anton Korinek
services_source.measurement: Model-based estimates, not observed consolidated sales
services_source.construction: Inference is assumed to be 50% of compute spending; service revenue is 1.5 times inference spending.
services_source.license_note: Only the cited numerical table entries are transcribed.

reference_year_reason: Align the revenue year with the beginning of the January 2024--April 2026 price window; do not treat a later revenue estimate as the initial size.

price.title: Artificial Intelligence markets: Recent developments and competition issues
price.measurement: Quality-adjusted cloud API price index, text-to-text models
price.role: Conditional price reference, not identified monopoly RSI productivity
price.numeraire_assumption: General final-good price held constant over the observation window

maintained_choices.macro_parameters: Existing global-paper benchmarks, not recalibrated to the United States
maintained_choices.interpretation: US sector intensity borrowed as a provisional reference for the stylized economy; neither a global estimate nor a full US calibration

research_moment.reason: The source's training/revenue ratio is imposed by its accounting assumptions. It is not independent evidence for B0. Company reports additionally mix projections, amortization and current compute expenditure.
